CommunityApplications.Profile: nas4webtrees: the original, unmodified [webtrees](https://webtrees.net/) (online genealogy) for NAS and home servers — SQLite, a short setup page in the browser, nightly GEDCOM backups and [api4webtrees](https://github.com/thobgg/api4webtrees) preinstalled, so the wtAnd, wtWin and wtTux apps connect with one click. Community project, not an official part of webtrees.
